title: Account and security
subtitle: Your sign-in methods, active sessions, and security activity.

password.title: Password
password.neverChanged: Not changed since the account was created.
password.hint: At least 10 characters with a letter and a number. Common passwords and ones containing your username or email are rejected. Other sessions are signed out.
password.changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Every sign-in needs a code from your authenticator app, a recovery code, or a passkey.
twoFactor.recoveryRemaining: {count, plural, =0 {No recovery codes left} one {# of {total, number} recovery codes left} other {# of {total, number} recovery codes left}}
twoFactor.regenerateStepUp: New codes replace all previous recovery codes.
twoFactor.replaceStepUp: Confirm with your current authenticator before you switch to a new one.
twoFactor.replaced: Authenticator replaced. Other sessions were signed out.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in without a password using Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a security key.
passkeys.addHint: Name the passkey and confirm with your authenticator code. Your browser then asks for the passkey.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.unavailable: Passkeys need an HTTPS app URL with a domain name. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL accordingly.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.removeStepUp: Confirm with your authenticator to remove {name}.

sessions.title: Active sessions
sessions.description: Devices that are signed in to your account.
sessions.othersRevoked: {count, plural, one {# session signed out} other {# sessions signed out}}
sessions.device: {browser, select, unknown {Unknown browser} other {{browser}}} on {system, select, unknown {an unknown system} other {{system}}}
sessions.factor: {factor, select, TOTP {Authenticator} RECOVERY {Recovery code} PASSKEY {Passkey} SSO {Single sign-on} other {Unknown}}

managementKeys.title: Management API keys
managementKeys.description: Automate console tasks through {path}. A key acts as you and keeps only the permissions you pick that your role still grants.
managementKeys.createHint: Pick what the key may do, then confirm with your authenticator code. The key is shown once.
managementKeys.name: Name
managementKeys.expiryOption: {days, plural, =0 {Never} =30 {In 30 days} =90 {In 90 days} =365 {In one year} other {In # days}}
managementKeys.none: Your role has no permissions that a management key can use.
managementKeys.revokeDescription: Scripts that use this key stop working immediately.
managementKeys.secretHint: The full key is shown only this once. Send it as Authorization: Bearer to {path}.

activity.title: Security activity
activity.description: Recent changes to your sign-in methods.
activity.actor: {actor, select, self {By you} user {By {name}} other {By the system}}
